runsheet.short_description: Set out boards and number them.
runsheet.long_description: (Dummy) Follow the floor plan. Put a number card on every board and keep spare pins at the help desk.

runsheet.short_description: Announce that the session has started.
runsheet.long_description: (Dummy) Short announcement only. Remind people where the posters for remote presenters are.

runsheet.short_description: Walk the floor and answer questions.
runsheet.long_description: (Dummy) Report empty boards to the [[Session Chair]].

runsheet.short_description: Announce the end; presenters take posters down.
